patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,9 +1,110 @@
-class BowlingGame:
-    def __init__(self):
-        pass
-
-    def roll(self, pins):
-        pass
-
-    def score(self):
-        pass
+class BowlingGame:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.rolls = []
+        self.frame_scores = []
+        self.current_frame = 0
+        self.frame_rolls = []
+        self.game_over = False
+
+    def roll(self, pins):
+        if self.game_over:
+            raise ValueError("Cannot roll after game is over")
+        if pins < 0 or pins > 10:
+            raise ValueError("Pins must be between 0 and 10")
+            
+        # Check if current frame is valid
+        if len(self.frame_rolls) == 0:
+            # First roll of frame
+            self.frame_rolls.append(pins)
+            self.rolls.append(pins)
+            if pins == 10 and self.current_frame < 9:  # Strike (not in 10th frame)
+                self.frame_scores.append((10, True, False))  # (score, is_strike, is_spare)
+                self.current_frame += 1
+                self.frame_rolls = []
+        else:
+            # Second roll of frame
+            if self.frame_rolls[0] + pins > 10:
+                raise ValueError("Cannot roll more pins than remaining")
+                
+            is_spare = (self.frame_rolls[0] + pins == 10) and self.current_frame < 9
+            is_strike = self.frame_rolls[0] == 10 and self.current_frame < 9
+            
+            self.frame_rolls.append(pins)
+            self.rolls.append(pins)
+            
+            self.frame_scores.append((self.frame_rolls[0] + self.frame_rolls[1], is_strike, is_spare))
+            self.current_frame += 1
+            self.frame_rolls = []
+            
+        # Handle 10th frame
+        if self.current_frame == 9:
+            if len(self.frame_rolls) == 0:
+                self.frame_rolls.append(pins)
+                self.rolls.append(pins)
+            elif len(self.frame_rolls) == 1:
+                # Check for valid second roll in 10th frame
+                if self.frame_rolls[0] < 10 and self.frame_rolls[0] + pins > 10:
+                    raise ValueError("Cannot roll more pins than remaining")
+                self.frame_rolls.append(pins)
+                self.rolls.append(pins)
+            elif len(self.frame_rolls) == 2:
+                # Check for valid third roll in 10th frame
+                # If first two rolls are a strike, third can be anything
+                # If first roll is not strike but first two are a spare, third can be anything
+                # If open frame, no third roll
+                frame_sum = self.frame_rolls[0] + self.frame_rolls[1]
+                if frame_sum < 10:
+                    raise ValueError("Cannot roll after game is over")
+                if (self.frame_rolls[0] == 10 or frame_sum == 10) and pins <= 10:
+                    self.frame_rolls.append(pins)
+                    self.rolls.append(pins)
+                    self.game_over = True
+                else:
+                    raise ValueError("Cannot roll after game is over")
+            # Check if 10th frame is complete
+            if len(self.frame_rolls) == 2:
+                frame_sum = self.frame_rolls[0] + self.frame_rolls[1]
+                if frame_sum < 10:
+                    self.frame_scores.append((frame_sum, False, False))
+                    self.game_over = True
+            elif len(self.frame_rolls) == 3:
+                self.frame_scores.append((sum(self.frame_rolls), False, False))
+                self.game_over = True
+
+    def score(self):
+        if not self.game_over and (self.current_frame < 10 or (self.current_frame == 9 and len(self.frame_rolls) > 0)):
+            raise ValueError("Game is not yet complete")
+            
+        total_score = 0
+        roll_index = 0
+        
+        for frame in range(10):
+            if frame < 9:  # Frames 1-9
+                frame_score, is_strike, is_spare = self.frame_scores[frame]
+                total_score += frame_score
+                
+                if is_strike:
+                    # Add next two rolls
+                    if frame + 1 < len(self.frame_scores):
+                        next_frame_score, next_is_strike, _ = self.frame_scores[frame + 1]
+                        if next_is_strike and frame + 2 < len(self.frame_scores):
+                            # Strike followed by strike
+                            total_score += 10 + self.frame_scores[frame + 2][0]
+                        else:
+                            # Strike followed by open frame or spare
+                            total_score += next_frame_score
+                    else:
+                        # This shouldn't happen if game is complete
+                        pass
+                elif is_spare:
+                    # Add next one roll
+                    if frame + 1 < len(self.frame_scores):
+                        total_score += self.frame_scores[frame + 1][0]
+                    else:
+                        # This shouldn't happen if game is complete
+                        pass
+            else:  # 10th frame
+                frame_score, _, _ = self.frame_scores[frame]
+                total_score += frame_score
+                
+        return total_score
